canonical_total_bytes = 0
    for bundle_name, prerequisite, result_key in (
        ('canonical-hb-4a49405b-from576.bundle', PARENT, 'canonical_bundle'),
        ('canonical-hb-4a49405b-from02b.bundle', BASE_COMMIT, 'canonical_x230_bundle'),
    ):
        bundle_remaining = 4 * 1024 * 1024 - canonical_total_bytes
        assert bundle_remaining > 0
        canonical_path = CONTROL / bundle_name
        assert not os.path.lexists(canonical_path)
        git(SOURCE, 'bundle', 'create', '--version=2', str(canonical_path), 'HEAD', '^' + prerequisite)
        canonical_raw = stable_read(canonical_path, bundle_remaining)
        assert 0 < len(canonical_raw) <= bundle_remaining
        canonical_total_bytes += len(canonical_raw)
        canonical_identity = identity(canonical_path.lstat())
        assert stat.S_IMODE(canonical_path.lstat().st_mode) == 0o600
        canonical_header = canonical_bundle_header(canonical_raw, prerequisite)
        fd = os.open(canonical_path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            assert identity(os.fstat(fd)) == canonical_identity
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        fsync_dir(CONTROL)
        git(SOURCE, 'bundle', 'verify', str(canonical_path))
        assert git(SOURCE, 'bundle', 'list-heads', str(canonical_path)).decode().strip() == COMMIT + ' HEAD'
        assert identity(canonical_path.lstat()) == canonical_identity
        assert stable_read(canonical_path, bundle_remaining) == canonical_raw
        result[result_key] = {'path': str(canonical_path), 'bytes': len(canonical_raw),
                                      'sha256': digest(canonical_raw), 'header': canonical_header,
                                      'identity': list(canonical_identity),
                                      'public_network_import_required_on_mac': False}
    result['canonical_bundle_total_bytes'] = canonical_total_bytes
    result['canonical_bundle_total_cap_bytes'] = 4 * 1024 * 1024
